description: This file defines a React component for the upload page in a Next.js frontend. It manages file selection, validation, upload process, and deletion of uploaded documents. It interacts with backend APIs via imported modules and displays UI elements for user interaction.

methods.name: onPick
methods.description: Handles file selection, validating file type and size, and setting the selected file state.

methods.name: onUpload
methods.description: Uploads the selected document to the backend API, handles response, and updates UI states.

methods.name: onDeleteUploaded
methods.description: Deletes the uploaded document via API call and resets local state.
